cta.headline: Compare lawyer quotes side by side before you sign
cta.copy: A spreadsheet that puts up to 3 quotes on the same basis (hourly, flat, retainer or contingency), a fee-agreement review checklist, consultation questions and a bill tracker to check invoices against the agreement.
cta.imageAlt: Quote comparison sheet showing three lawyer quotes converted to an estimated total

cta.headline: Budget your divorce before the retainer runs out
cta.copy: Estimate legal fees by scenario, track retainer draw-down, and plan the household budget for two homes, with filled examples and a printable workbook.
cta.imageAlt: Divorce budget planner showing a retainer balance chart

cta.headline: Leave your family a map, not a mystery
cta.copy: A fillable organizer listing where documents are, who to call and which accounts exist, without storing passwords or full account numbers. It is not a will.
cta.imageAlt: Pages of the family information binder

cta.headline: Organize your small claims case in one place
cta.copy: A case organizer with damages math, a demand-letter worksheet, evidence and witness logs, and a court-day checklist, plus a fee and limit reference for the states we have verified.
cta.imageAlt: Small claims organizer with damages calculation

cta.headline: All four planning kits
cta.copy: Toolkit, divorce planner, family binder and small claims kit for $59 instead of $89 bought separately.
